notes.title: 🎮 SHUNYA Demo Updated
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’ve just updated the [b]SHUNYA demo[/b] with several improvements based on your feedback:[/p][list][*][p][b]New sound effects[/b] for actions and environments[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved pixel art and character animations[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Better story presentation[/b] – more polished cutscenes and interactions[/p][/*][*][p][b]New loading screen[/b] to enhance the game feel[/p][/*][*][p]Now includes Japanese subtitles (machine translated). A more natural and accurate version will be added in future updates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615837/02bf35e77d98ff16a89c7a896d397a5c8d9564c5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615837/6cdc26f78e48b00c55ff9564accdfb3f641f2884.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615837/fa0dd1e78425590847e654dc1c3b14e7e4346514.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615837/b79062ccfa16a6ec119481c7b50e6929938e31e2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615837/341284da15d67e6c3bd7dbf29b6acc88eda39101.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]This update brings the game one step closer to our vision.
If you’ve played before, we’d love for you to try the new version.
If this is your first time, welcome to SHUNYA – and let us know what you think!
Thanks for your support,[/p][p]— Morleaf Studio 🌿  

[b]#summergamesfest#indiegame#SEAGShowcase[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Gameplay
notes.content: Gameplay for game SHUNYA for first two world level, it will spent around 30 minutes to 1 hour for the game, it is a 2D Platformer Puzzle Games, the main mechanism for my game is drawing cube to help the girl to destination. In the demo, player can draw Earth Cube to solve Puzzle, please enjoy it ~
